craft_notes: Sthāyin: alternating five. Rows: count then sides. Read aloud: pendulum.

lines: Then nine hundred breath-tosses — by count, without, two clocks and a half — left, right, left, right, left — five crossings.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tato navaśatāni prāṇavikṣepāṇām iti gaṇanayā bahiḥ sārdhaghaṭikādvayaṃ vāme dakṣiṇe vāme dakṣiṇe vāme iti pañca saṃkrāntayaḥ
